![](https://i.imgur.com/Le7cALn.png)

Forge 1.13+ использует проект Forge team's [CoreMods](https://github.com/MinecraftForge/CoreMods) вместо проекта Sponge team's [Mixin](https://github.com/SpongePowered/Mixin).

Forge 1.12 использует проект Sponge team's [Mixin](https://github.com/SpongePowered/Mixin), который не требует [MixinBootstrap](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mixinbootstrap).

Если у вас возникают сбои при использовании версии 1.12, возможно, вам потребуется [MixinCompat](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mixin-0-7-0-8-compatibility) или переименование [MixinBootstrap](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mixinbootstrap), как описано [здесь](https://github.com/LXGaming/MixinBootstrap/issues/38).

#### Другие моды:
- [Durability Viewer (LiteLoader 1.7.10–1.8.9)](https://minecraft.curseforge.com/projects/durability-viewer)
- [Durability101 (Vanilla, ML и Forge 1.3.2–1.6.2)](https://www.minecraftforum.net/forums/mapping-and-modding-java-edition/minecraft-mods/1285383-1-6-2-jul-13-durability101-hotbar-visible-use)

[Смело используйте в любом модпаке](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/durability101)
